about.title: Agoura Hills Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing a family member in a collision changes everything, and the practical questions that follow can feel overwhelming on top of the grief. Agoura Hills sees dozens of injury collisions each year along corridors like Kanan Road, Agoura Road, the Ventura Freeway, and Reyes Adobe Road, and while recent years have not recorded traffic fatalities here, serious crashes elsewhere in Los Angeles County still lead to wrongful death claims for local families. California law limits who may bring this type of claim, sets a firm filing deadline, and defines specific losses a family can seek to recover. We handle wrongful death claims and can review what happened, explain your options in plain terms, and manage the legal work while you focus on your family. There's no fee unless we recover something for you.

whyChoose.title: What Agoura Hills Families Should Know

items.title: Only Certain Family Members Can File
items.desc: California law limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible in some cases. We can clarify who in your family qualifies before any claim moves forward.

items.title: The Clock Starts at Two Years
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim in California, though claims against a government entity carry a much shorter window. Acting sooner preserves evidence and options.

items.title: Recoverable Losses Go Beyond Bills
items.desc: California allows families to seek funeral costs and lost financial support, but also the loss of love, companionship, and guidance — losses that are harder to put a number on but are still recognized under the law.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Typically a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children have the first right to file. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may qualify depending on the family's circumstances. We can review your situation and confirm where you stand.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as a criminal case?
items.answer: No. A criminal case, if one is filed, is brought by the state and focuses on punishment. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action brought by the family to recover financial and personal losses, and it can proceed regardless of the criminal outcome.

items.question: Does Agoura Hills have a lot of fatal crashes?
items.answer: Recent public crash data for Agoura Hills shows injury collisions concentrated on roads like Kanan Road, Agoura Road, and the Ventura Freeway, with no recorded traffic deaths in the most recent final year. Fatal crashes can still occur, and families dealing with a loss anywhere in Los Angeles County can reach out to discuss their options.
